note: Awards & recognition, in display order. tools/build_awards.py rewrites the section in index.html from this file. An item with an 'image' shows a small framed thumbnail that opens full size (the image files live in assets/awards/ as <slug>-240.{webp,jpg} and <slug>-full.{webp,jpg}; sizes below are their pixel dimensions). 'detail' may contain the token {SRI-B}, which becomes the abbreviation with its expansion. Keep 'Samsung (internal)' awards in their own group so external recognition is not diluted.
